family.description: This family represents a group of prokaryotic proteins associated with transmembrane transport of undecaprenyl phosphate lipids, which is required for the biogenesis of microbial cell surface polymers, including VCA0040 ([swissprot:Q9KNC5]) from Vibrio cholerae [[cite:PUB00103953]]. Family members have between 6 and 9 predicted transmembrane segments.
family.name: Undecaprenyl phosphate translocase-like
